newsitem.title: USA: Harvard declines comment on Chelsea Clinton report.
newsitem.headline: Harvard declines comment on Chelsea Clinton report.

text.p: Harvard University declined to comment on Thursday on a Los Angeles Times report that it had offered admission to Chelsea Clinton, the daughter of President Bill Clinton.

"Harvard's policy is to make no comment on such matters," Alex Huppe, a university spokesman, said. "It is strictly a matter between the school and the applicant. It is a private matter and we will not comment."

Chelsea Clinton, 16, made an autumn tour of the Ivy League schools in New England, visiting the campuses of Brown University in Providence, Rhode Island, and Yale University in New Haven, Connecticut, as well as Harvard.
There was no immediate comment from the White House.
